title: NCAA: JRU claims slim win over Lyceum for solo lead in Group A
summary: Jose Rizal University averted a late collapse in a slim 81-78 win over Lyceum in Group A of the NCAA Season 102 men's basketball tournament on Tuesday at the San Juan Arena.
